title: Creamy Cod, Smoked Salmon and Prawn Fish Pie
summary: A classic British fish pie with a silky creamy sauce, tender cod, smoky salmon and juicy prawns under a buttery mashed potato topping. Comforting and rich, it’s ideal for a cosy dinner.
steps: Put the potatoes in a large pan, cover with cold salted water and bring to a boil. Cook for 15–20 minutes until tender, then drain well and mash with a little butter, a splash of milk, a pinch of salt and the nutmeg. Set aside.
While the potatoes cook, heat the olive oil and half the butter in a large pan over medium heat. Add the onion and leek and cook for 8–10 minutes until soft and translucent, not browned.
Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk, cream and water until smooth, then simmer for 3–4 minutes until thick and glossy.
Stir the cornstarch into the lemon juice, then add it to the sauce along with the parsley, black pepper and remaining salt. Cook for 1 minute more.
Fold in the cod and prawns and cook gently for 2–3 minutes, just until the fish starts to turn opaque. Stir through the smoked salmon, then take the pan off the heat.
Spoon the fish mixture into a baking dish and top with the mashed potato, spreading it right to the edges. Rough up the surface with a fork for a crispier top and dot with the remaining butter.
Bake at 200°C for 25–30 minutes until bubbling at the edges and golden on top. Leave to rest for 5 minutes before serving.
